en: Due to the drought, the locks are closed for the first time in the watery west: 'It is code black, water extraction is prohibited from midnight'. Drought: From Wednesday night, the locks in the Delfland Water Board will be closed and a ban on extracting surface water will come into effect. That realization does not seem to have dawned on everyone yet. “Previously it was a theoretical model. This is it here and now.”
